name: Sign In: Split
summary: A split sign-in screen: the workspace sign-in form on the left, and a panel with a slowly flowing gradient background and an optional quote on the right.
useWhen: Adding a branded sign-in page to a product with accounts, with room for a quote or product mood on the right
A sign-in screen that stacks to one column on phones, with the decorative panel either below the form or hidden
avoidWhen: The page has to be as light as possible, since the panel animates continuously unless reduced motion is set
source: Form from workspace/auth-05; the flow panel is written for this library
